sentences.text: Teman Eko menjelaskan bahwa matahari sebagian besar terdiri dari hidrogen.
sentences.en: Eko's friend explained that the sun is mostly made of hydrogen.
sentences.ko: 에코의 친구는 태양이 대부분 수소로 이루어져 있다고 설명했어요.

sentences.text: Salah satu sponsor lomba adalah perusahaan bus berbahan bakar hidrogen.
sentences.en: One of the race sponsors is a hydrogen-fueled bus company.
sentences.ko: 대회 후원사 가운데 하나는 수소 버스 회사예요.

sentences.text: Eko membawa tali dari serat sabut kelapa untuk mengikat terpal.
sentences.en: Eko brought rope made of coconut husk fiber to tie the tarp.
sentences.ko: 에코는 방수포를 묶으려고 코코넛 껍질 섬유로 만든 밧줄을 가져왔어요.

sentences.text: Ayu banyak makan sayur berserat menjelang hari lomba.
sentences.en: Ayu eats a lot of fibrous vegetables in the days before the race.
sentences.ko: 아유는 대회 날이 다가오면 섬유질 채소를 많이 먹어요.

sentences.text: Di dekat perkemahan, Eko melihat bekas tambang timah yang sudah ditutup.
sentences.en: Near the campsite, Eko saw an old tin mine that has been closed.
sentences.ko: 에코는 캠프장 근처에서 문 닫은 옛 주석 광산을 봤어요.

sentences.text: Kota tempat Ayu berlari dulu terkenal sebagai pusat tambang timah.
sentences.en: The town where Ayu ran used to be famous as a tin mining center.
sentences.ko: 아유가 뛴 도시는 예전에 주석 광산 중심지로 유명했어요.

sentences.text: Ayu memilih berlari pagi agar tidak kepanasan karena hawa siang terlalu terik.
sentences.en: Ayu chose to run in the morning to avoid overheating because the midday heat is too fierce.
sentences.ko: 한낮 더위가 너무 심해서 아유는 더위 먹지 않으려고 아침에 뛰기로 했어요.
